note: Pre-registered lead from output/research/walters_factors.md: in night games between teams from different time zones, the more western team beat the closing spread by ~2 points (2003-22 t=3.4; 2023-25 +2.2±1.05, 56.5% covers, n=113). Found by inspecting 2003-22 results, so 2026+ is the clean test. Lines do not move toward it during the week, so it is bet just before kickoff. Do not edit to fit results; bump version instead.

qualify.bet: the more western team's spread at the allowed book with the best value (number and price) vs the all-book consensus

validation.test: one-sided binomial test of wins vs the break-even rate implied by the prices taken (pushes excluded); CLV is recorded but is not the test, because the market does not move toward this factor
